distinctive_features.feature: Pulse dashboards visualize attendance, learning, and wellbeing, including cohort and year-level comparisons.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: School leaders can review several operational domains and compare groups from a shared analytics view.

distinctive_features.feature: CompassFMS includes general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, budgets, purchase orders, and fixed assets.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can connect student-facing fees with broader finance operations in the same platform.

distinctive_features.feature: Family payments connect consent and events with invoices, payment plans, donations, Wallet, canteen orders, and Shop.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Families can handle multiple school transactions through connected payment workflows.

distinctive_features.feature: Public REST API documentation and a sandbox support custom integrations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools and partners can test integrations and extend the platform beyond its named connectors.

distinctive_features.feature: Chronicle and Digest provide wellbeing records, selected-student updates, and configurable access controls.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Staff can coordinate sensitive pastoral workflows while restricting access to appropriate roles.

distinctive_features.feature: Inklass acquisition adds a school-branded mobile-app strategy with integrations across school systems.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can pursue a more unified, branded mobile experience for families.

distinctive_features.feature: The UK service describes per-customer databases, automated failover, and a 99.9% availability commitment.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These documented service measures offer procurement-relevant evidence about resilience for that service.

weaknesses.issue: Pricing is quote-only, with no public tiers, per-student rate, or implementation price.
The Android app has a 3.4/5 rating and reports include sign-outs, difficult login, crashes, and confusing navigation.
iOS reviews report limited mobile access to resources or feedback and friction with payment confirmation and card entry.
Mobile workflows can differ from the browser, and some functions depend on school configuration or optional modules.
G2 shows only one review, so its displayed rating provides little evidence about typical customer experience.
Native transport, library, hostel, and formal examination modules are not publicly evidenced; integrations do not establish native coverage.
No production AI assistant or predictive analytics capability is publicly documented.

pricing_model_summary: No public list pricing; prospects request a demo or vendor quote. Pricing, implementation, migration, training, support, payments, and branded-app costs require confirmation.
biggest_strategic_gap: Mobile usability, especially Android, is a notable weakness in an otherwise broad K–12 suite; specialist native modules and documented AI capabilities are also limited.
